verdict.rationale: AiPrise is a SaaS compliance and KYC platform, and buyers can fairly ask whether such a product offers on-prem or self-hosted deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a vendor-hosted service ('fully hosted, customizable flow'), APIs and SDKs, with no documented self-hosting or on-prem option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
